title: Emacs Doom Episode 1 - Getting Started
summary: A short first episode in Zaiste's Doom Emacs series, showing how to get started with Doom, an Emacs configuration aimed at Vim users. It presents Doom as a polished, fast, batteries-included distribution.
why: HN users recommend the series to newcomers learning Emacs, Doom, org-mode, projectile and magit.

quote.text: To get started I highly recommend this series by Zaiste
